title: Shears
pitch: Giant tailor's shears: cut a piece out of the paper world, carry it folded on your back, paste it anywhere as new ground.
howto: Drag a box on the terrain to SNIP a piece, then tap anywhere in reach to PASTE it. Bridge gaps, tunnel through walls, squash paper pests - your carried piece even soaks a hit before it tears. Earn scraps for a bigger clipboard, sharper shears and reinforced paper.
controls: Drag on the paper to cut, tap to paste, on-screen arrows + jump. Keyboard: WASD/Space, J snip, K rotate. Gamepad: A jump, X snip/paste, B rotate.
